Mia (support): Invoice for Nordic Parts AB is stuck on hold — PO #NP-487. Customer provided VAT ID SE123456789701 (has branch suffix '01') and our system flags it as invalid. Any idea if PO ingestion strips branch suffix? cc @Ashwin
Ashwin (billing): We don't strip by default. VIES expects base VAT (SE1234567897) in most cases. If the PO feed sends the full 12-digit with branch, the external lookup fails.
Mia (support): Ah ok. Customer is asking us to apply reverse charge — they need invoice without VAT while we verify. They can't pay otherwise.
billing-bot: webhook:invoice.updated id=inv_0009 status=on_hold reason=vatted_country_mismatch payload_vat=SE123456789701
Jordan (eng): Can you paste the raw webhook payload and the invoice id? need to repro ingestion.
Mia (support): payload snippet: ```{
  "po_number": "NP-487",
  "vat_id": "SE123456789701",
  "customer": "Nordic Parts AB"
}``` invoice id inv_0009
Ashwin (billing): Quick workaround: billing console supports manual VAT override on the invoice page (Finance -> Invoices -> inv_0009 -> Edit VAT). I'll do it after we confirm. Long term: ingestion should normalize SE VATs by removing 2-digit branch suffix when length == 12. Proposed regex: `^([A-Z]{2})(\d{10})(?:\d{2})?$` then use group 1+2 for lookup.
Jordan (eng): ok I can add a small normalizer in the PO ingestion lambda. Will add unit + integration test against VIES sandbox. Estimated deploy today if no blockers.
Elaine (customer success): I'll tell the customer we're doing a manual override now and will follow up once ingestion fix is live. They asked for ETA.
Mia (support): Great — Ashwin please confirm once override done and Jordan please drop PR link when ready. Thanks :+1:
Ashwin (billing): Done — manual override applied, invoice moved to pending_payment. Notified customer. :white_check_mark:
Jordan (eng): PR: https://git.internal/redwood/po-ingest/pulls/42 — normalizer + test. Deploy scheduled to staging 16:30 UTC.
Mia (support): Closing loop with customer. I'll open a billing-ops ticket to track revert and audit entries. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
